cohort: 25 cases of ectopic pregnancies at Liaquat University Hospital Hyderabad from January 2018 to December 2018.
finding: Risk factors for ectopic pregnancy included previous miscarriage, infertility treatment, previous ectopic pregnancy, cesarean section, and pelvic inflammatory diseases, with the majority of patients being between 20-30 years old and having a gestational age of 2 months.
